in_sanskrit.name: एकनाथ
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is free from all defects and is truthful

in_marathi.name: Eknaath
in_marathi.long_meaning: Eknaath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Eknaath is derived from Sanskrit words 'Ek' meaning one and 'Nath' meaning lord. This name signifies being devoted to one supreme deity or being the one who leads others towards the path of God.
